Battleglove.name: Battleglove
Battleglove.description:
An exotic heavy gauntlet, that covers your hand and forearm. Provides three option slots.

Remember to set HL to 0 when installing cyberware options.

Smart Glasses.name: Smart Glasses
Smart Glasses.description:
Eyewear with two options slots for cybereye options.

Remember to set HL to 0 when installing cyberware options.

Agent.name: Agent
Agent.description: A Standard Quality AI Smartpohone that provides +2 Library Search, +2 Wardrobe & Style depending on circumstance. Includes a touchscreen, microphone, camera, and flashlight.

Audio Recorder.name: Audio Recorder
Audio Recorder.description: Record up to 24 hours of audio on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.LKAYRh3Oecskc6kH]{Memory Chip}.

Auto Level Dampening Ear Protectors.name: Auto Level Dampening Ear Protectors
Auto Level Dampening Ear Protectors.description: Wearer is immune to loud sounds like those produced by @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_ammo.Item.e8gDMbdK1oPKwhqW]{Flashbang Grenades}.

Carryall.name: Carryall
Carryall.description: A bag to carry and conceal items.

Chemical Analyzer.name: Chemical Analyzer
Chemical Analyzer.description:
Determines the chemical composition of a sample.

Your GM may require a related Intelligence or Tech check.

Computer.name: Computer
Computer.description: A budget Desktop or laptop that cannot be used as a Portable Net Arch

Cryopump.name: Cryopump
Cryopump.description:
Briefcase-sized tool used for hooking up a wounded person. Places them in stasis.

Can only be used by a Medtech with Cryopump training

Cryotank.name: Cryotank
Cryotank.description:
Holds a fully-sized human, heals injuries faster than normal.

Can only be used by a Medtech with Cryopump training

Drum Synthesizer.name: Drum Synthesizer
Drum Synthesizer.description: Makes drum sounds when connected to @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.Zp8YbDBMTCl7sy61]{amplifier}.

Electric Guitar/Other Instrument.name: Electric Guitar/Other Instrument
Electric Guitar/Other Instrument.description: Musical instrument. Electric instruments requires an @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.Zp8YbDBMTCl7sy61]{amplifier}.

Flashlight.name: Flashlight
Flashlight.description: 10h of light on a single charge. 100m/yd range.

Grapple Gun.name: Grapple Gun
Grapple Gun.description:
Range: 30m/yds.

Not usable as weapon, cannot be used to Grapple an opponent.

Handcuffs.name: Handcuffs
Handcuffs.description: Physically restrain any individual with less than 10 BODY.

Homing Tracer.name: Homing Tracer
Homing Tracer.description: Track a linked @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.IqXTqNGBmSuigIWv]{Tracer Button} up to 1 mile.

Linear Frame β (Beta).name: Linear Frame β (Beta)
Linear Frame β (Beta).description:
Exoskeleton.

  • Requires 2 @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.KofoAolDFb3rvpbL]{Interface Plugs}
  • Increases BODY to 14 while plugged in

Does not affect HP or Deathsave due to BODY increase — Not currently supported by system

Linear Frame ∑ (Sigma).name: Linear Frame ∑ (Sigma)
Linear Frame ∑ (Sigma).description:
Exoskeleton.

  • Requires 1 @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.KofoAolDFb3rvpbL]{Interface Plug}
  • Increases BODY to 12

Does not affect HP or Deathsave due to BODY increase — Not currently supported by system

Medtech Bag.name: Medtech Bag
Medtech Bag.description: A bag filled with basic medical equipment.

Memory Chip.name: Memory Chip
Memory Chip.description:
Universal data storage device.

Not compatible with @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.IJarQGKk5rPayoLT]{Chipware Sockets}

Personal CarePak.name: Personal CarePak
Personal CarePak.description: Contains a toothbrush and other personal grooming items.

Pocket Amplifier.name: Pocket Amplifier
Pocket Amplifier.description: @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_ammo.Item.MfuoJ69NL1FiP7B8]{Battery} powered electronic device that can support up to two electronic instruments.

Spray Paint.name: Spray Paint
Spray Paint.description: Generic spraypaint. Make some art or blind a camera.

Tech Bag.name: Tech Bag
Tech Bag.description: Tool bag filled with basic tools for everyday repairs.

Techscanner.name: Techscanner
Techscanner.description: An electronic device that grants +2 to to Basic Tech, Cybertech, Electronic/Security Tech, Weaponstech, Land Vehicle Tech, Sea Vehicle Tech, Air Vehicle Tech checks.

Techtool.name: Techtool
Techtool.description: Multi-purpose tool that fits in your pocket.

Tent and Camping Equipment.name: Tent and Camping Equipment
Tent and Camping Equipment.description: Provides shelter from the weather and space for one person.

Tracer Button.name: Tracer Button
Tracer Button.description: Can be tracked from up to a mile away with a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.QIHx5oQOirtTlAaD]{Homing Tracer}.

Vial of Biotoxin.name: Vial of Biotoxin
Vial of Biotoxin.description: Deals [[/r 3d6dmg#Biotoxin Damage]]{3d6 Damage} damage directly to HP unless subject makes a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs} check. Armor does not apply.

Vial of Poison.name: Vial of Poison
Vial of Poison.description: Deals [[/r 23d6dmg#Biotoxin Damage]]{2d6 Damage} damage directly to HP unless subject makes a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs} check. Armor does not apply.

Video Camera.name: Video Camera
Video Camera.description: Record up to 12 hours of vidio on a @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_gear.Item.LKAYRh3Oecskc6kH]{Memory Chip}.
